help.not_reportable: Żadna kategoria nie ma zastosowania. Uzasadnij — decyzja negatywna to też dokument.
help.death: Osoba zmarła wskutek wypadku przy pracy. Powiadom niezwłocznie; raport w 10 dni.
help.specified_injury: A worker suffered a Schedule 1 injury: any fracture other than to fingers, thumbs or toes; amputation; permanent or likely-permanent loss or reduction of sight; a crush injury to the head or torso causing damage to the brain or internal organs; a serious burn covering more than 10% of the body or damaging the eyes, respiratory system or other vital organs; scalping requiring hospital treatment; loss of consciousness caused by head injury or asphyxia; or, from working in an enclosed space, any injury leading to hypothermia, heat-induced illness or resuscitation, or requiring admission to hospital for more than 24 hours. Report within 10 days.
help.non_worker_hospital: A person not at work (a visitor, a delivery driver, a member of the public) was injured by a work-related accident and taken from the scene to hospital for treatment. Reportable regardless of how serious the injury turns out to be. Report within 10 days.
help.over_7_day: The worker is incapacitated for routine work for more than 7 consecutive days, not counting the day of the accident. Report within 15 days of the accident.
help.occupational_disease: Rozpoznana choroba zawodowa związana z pracą — cieśń nadgarstka, dermatoza, astma zawodowa, HAVS, zapalenie ścięgien, nowotwór zawodowy.
help.dangerous_occurrence: Zdarzenie z załącznika 2 — awaria dźwignicy, zawalenie rusztowania, pożar/wybuch elektryczny, awaria ciśnieniowa, uwolnienie substancji.
help.gas_incident: Zgon lub uraz związany z gazem albo niebezpieczna instalacja gazowa.
